title: Structural data for coherent homomorphisms over an open complement
statement: For every X, I, F, G and hypotheses of Lemma 01YB, the structural data U, r, stalk and restriction properties, compatible cocone and bijective colimit map exist.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (label lemma-homs-over-open); its proof uses Properties lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open, lemma-quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type, Lemmas 01Y8 (lemma-acc-coherent), Artin-Rees (lemma-Artin-Rees) and the quasi-coherence of the sheaf Hom from a finitely presented module

proof.text: Obtain the ideal module quasicoherence from the affine product theorem at exponent one. Its finite type follows from the proved finite-type-ideal-module theorem and the Noetherian finite-type-ideal fact. Apply sections_over_quasiCompact_open to get U, its stalk characterization, and bijectivity of all ideal powers on every open inside U.

Construct each transition r n m from formalModuleQuotient_factor for the identity of G. The factors are uniquely determined by the monomorphic product inclusions, so choices are not arbitrary data. Prove all product inclusions are isomorphisms after restriction: ideal_module_product_stalk identifies their stalk ranges with I_x^n G_x, which is the whole stalk on U; handle exponent zero using the identity ideal. Stalkwise bijectivity gives sectionwise bijectivity on every open inside U and thus an isomorphism in the over-site category.

Cancel the monomorphic inclusions to prove the identity and composition laws of r. Define D n as AddCommGrpCat.of (I^n G -> F) and D.map by precomposition. Define the restriction cocone using the inverse of the restricted product inclusion. Its naturality follows by cancellation and hcomp; its required compatibility follows from the inverse identities.

For surjectivity of colimit.desc use finite-stage extension and the colimit cocone identity. For injectivity represent a class by chi at stage n, using Mathlib Concrete.colimit_exists_rep and preservation of the filtered colimit by forget. If its cocone image is zero, the restriction of chi is zero. Eventual vanishing supplies a later stage where r followed by chi is zero; colimit.w makes the original class zero. The additive map kernel criterion gives injectivity. Package U, r and the proved properties as CoherentHomsOverOpenData.

proof_origin.reason: Lean construction following Stacks Project Lemma 01YB; retain the geometric surjectivity and eventual-vanishing steps separately, construct and verify the Hom diagram and colimit comparison explicitly.

    [CompactSpace X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) :
    Nonempty (CoherentHomsOverOpenData I F G)
